api_analysis.hypothesis: The fatal error is that the C++ compiler (g++) cannot find cudnn.h when compiling kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp because CUDA include paths are only added for .cu files compiled by nvcc. The binding .cpp should not directly include cudnn.h. Instead, all cuDNN code must reside in the .cu file, which is compiled by nvcc and has access to CUDA/cuDNN include paths. The .cpp binding should only include torch headers and call an extern "C" launcher from the .cu file.

The rejected candidate attempted to move cuDNN code to .cu, which is the correct direction to fix the missing header.
The current binding includes <cudnn.h> and implements cuDNN calls directly in the .cpp, causing the failure.
The task allows cuDNN usage and requires it for ConvTranspose; it does not forbid implementing it in .cu.

Ensure the launcher signature matches between .cu and .cpp.
Keep model_new.py unchanged as it already calls the correct extension functions.
